fields.Name: T146 - New Component Dialog
fields.Description: Exercises the new-component-dialog reactive form (type-card selection + required-field validation gating the Create button) — a bespoke creation flow distinct from generic entity create.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Component Studio app (Components section), click the 'New Component' button. Verify the 'Create New Component' dialog opens showing a Name field (marked required), a Type selection rendered as a card grid, a Title field, and a Description textarea. Confirm the 'Create' button is DISABLED while Name is empty, then type a name and verify 'Create' becomes enabled. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the dialog render with its fields and the Create button gating on the required Name is success — you do NOT need to actually create the component (you may Cancel).

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'New Component' opens a 'Create New Component' dialog with a required Name field, a Type card grid, Title, and Description
The 'Create' button is disabled with an empty Name and becomes enabled after a name is entered
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
